title: Expanding Single Brackets
subject: Maths
learning_objective: Expand expressions with a single bracket by multiplying every term inside the bracket by the term outside, handling negative multipliers correctly.

question_structure.Q1-Q15: Basic: simple positive integer multiplied by a two-term bracket
question_structure.Q16-Q30: Intermediate: larger coefficients, negative multipliers, three-term brackets
question_structure.Q31-Q45: Advanced: negatives, higher powers, and multi-term expressions

answer_key.Mistake1_correct: 6x + 9 (must multiply BOTH terms inside the bracket)
answer_key.Mistake2_correct: -2x - 8 (a negative times a positive gives a negative)
